# Page text data

We're interested in some measures:
1. What percent of paragraphs contain these genres of keywords?
2. What percent of pages that existed at the time contain these genres of keywords?

```{r Import data}

parent_dir <- "data/paragraphs_with_keywords"

# Get all directories of the format YYYY0101
dirs <- list.dirs(parent_dir)
dirs <- dirs[grepl("^data/paragraphs_with_keywords/\\d{4}0101$", dirs)]

# Initialize the data frames
pages_df <- data.frame()
revisions_df <- data.frame()
paragraphs_df <- data.frame()
counts_df <- data.frame()
corpus_df <- data.frame() # Number of total corpus pages by date

# Loop through the directories and stack the data frames
for (d in dirs) {
  # The term counter skips empty paragraphs and categories
  # We use the mask file to keep our data frames lined up
  skipped <- as.logical(readLines(file.path(d, "skipped_counts.txt")))
  pages <- readLines(file.path(d, "paragraphs_with_keywords_pages.txt"))[!skipped]
  revisions <- as.numeric(readLines(file.path(d, "paragraphs_with_keywords_revisions.txt")))[!skipped]
  paragraphs <- readLines(file.path(d, "paragraphs_with_keywords.txt"))[!skipped]
  counts <- read.csv(file.path(d, "term_counts.csv"))
  
  # Add pages, drop unnecessary variables
  counts$page <- pages
  counts <- counts[,-which(names(counts) %in% c("id","document","total_terms"))]

  if (!all(length(pages) == length(revisions),
         length(pages) == length(paragraphs),
         length(pages) == nrow(counts))) {
  warning("Length mismatch in ", d)
    print(paste("Pages:", length(pages)))
    print(paste("Revisions:", length(revisions)))
    print(paste("Paragraphs:", length(paragraphs)))
    print(paste("Counts:", nrow(counts)))
}
  
  fulldate <- as.Date(sub(".*/(\\d{8})$", "\\1", d), format = "%Y%m%d") - 1
  
  # Total corpus pages that existed at the time
  #print(sum(first_revisions$datetime < fulldate + 1))

  pages_df     <- rbind(pages_df,     data.frame(date = fulldate, page = pages))
  revisions_df <- rbind(revisions_df, data.frame(date = fulldate, revision = revisions))
  paragraphs_df <- rbind(paragraphs_df, data.frame(date = fulldate, paragraph = paragraphs))
  counts_df    <- rbind(counts_df,    data.frame(date = fulldate, counts))
  corpus_df    <- rbind(corpus_df, data.frame(date = fulldate, num_pages = sum(first_revisions$datetime < fulldate + 1)))
}


term_cols <- c(
  "population_genetics_methods","statistical_clustering","ancestry_and_origins","phenotype_physical",
  "medical_genetics","group_comparison","subsistence_mode","admixture_and_mixing","archaic_and_deep_lineage",
  "social_structure","migration_conquest","race_classification","identity_and_ethnicity",
  "language_and_linguistics","sourcing_and_evidence","religion","politics_and_statehood","hereditarian"
)

# Number of pages with paragraphs with keywords, per year
sum_pages_by_year <- pages_df %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(pages = n_distinct(page))

# Summarize counts by page (sums the topics mentioned, probably not super useful)
counts_df_sum <- counts_df %>%
  group_by(date, page) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(term_cols), sum), .groups="drop")

# Summarize counts by presence in paragraphs 
# This counts how many paragraphs in a page mention a topic
sum_pgh_presence_by_page <- counts_df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(term_cols), ~ as.integer(. != 0))) %>%
  group_by(date, page) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(term_cols), sum), .groups="drop")

# Summarize counts by presence in pages
# This counts how many pages mention a topic
sum_presence_by_page <- counts_df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(term_cols), ~ as.integer(. != 0))) %>%
  group_by(date, page) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(term_cols), sum), .groups="drop") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(term_cols), ~ as.integer(. != 0))) %>%
  group_by(date, page) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(term_cols), sum), .groups="drop")

#parent_dir <- "data/paragraphs_with_keywords/20100101"
```

```{r Plot time series of topics}

# Scope of topics
keep_cols <- c(
  "population_genetics_methods",
  "statistical_clustering",
  "ancestry_and_origins",
  "phenotype_physical",
  "medical_genetics",
  "group_comparison",
  "subsistence_mode",
  "admixture_and_mixing",
  "archaic_and_deep_lineage",
  "social_structure",
  "race_classification",
  "identity_and_ethnicity",
  "language_and_linguistics",
  "religion",
  "hereditarian")

names(keep_cols) <- c(
  "Popgen terminology",
  "Statistics & clustering",
  "Ancestry & origins",
  "Phenotypes",
  "Medical genetics",
  "Group comparisons",
  "Subsistence",
  "Admixture",
  "Archaic",
  "Social structure",
  "Race",
  "Identity & Ethnicity",
  "Language",
  "Religion",
  "Hereditarianism")

# Plot the proportion of pages per year that have a given topic.
# This gives the proportion of all pages in the corpus
df_plotting <- sum_presence_by_page %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(keep_cols), ~ sum(. != 0))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "topic", values_to = "count") %>%
  left_join(corpus_df) %>%
  left_join(sum_pages_by_year) %>%
  mutate(proportion_corpus = count/num_pages,
         proportion_pages = count/pages)

pal <- qualpal(
  n = length(keep_cols),
  colorspace = list(h = c(0, 360), s = c(0.3, 0.8), l = c(0.4, 0.85))
)

pal_cols <- pal$hex

label_data <- df_plotting %>%
  group_by(topic) %>%
  filter(date == max(date)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

label_push <- 5000

ggplot(df_plotting, aes(x=as.Date(date), y = proportion_pages, colour = topic)) + 
  geom_line() + 
  ggtitle("Topics present in paragraphs with genetics keywords") +
  ylab("Proportion of pages that have genetics keywords") + xlab("Date") +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = pal_cols
  ) + 
    geom_text_repel(
    data        = label_data,
    aes(label   = topic, color = topic),
    family      = "sans",
    fontface    = "bold",
    size        = 3.2,
    direction   = "y",           # repel vertically only
    xlim        = c(max(df_plotting$date) + label_push, NA),  # push labels past the last date
    hjust       = 0,
    segment.size      = .5,
    segment.alpha     = .5,
    segment.linetype  = "dotted",
    segment.curvature = -0.1,
    segment.ncp       = 3,
    segment.angle     = 20,
    box.padding       = .4
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") + # Coordinate system: clip = "off" lets labels render outside the panel
  scale_x_date(
    expand = c(0, 0),
    limits = c(as.Date("2001-01-01"), as.Date("2026-01-01")),  # extra room for labels
    date_breaks = "5 years",
    date_labels = "%Y"
  ) +
  theme_endline() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(5.5, 120, 5.5, 5.5))  # bigger right margin (pt)

#ggsave(file.path("figures","seeded_topics_pages.png"), device="png", bg = "grey98",
#                 width=10, height=6, dpi=300)
```

```{r Output tables}

# Plot the proportion of pages per year that have a given topic.
# This gives the proportion of all pages in the corpus
summary_table <- sum_presence_by_page %>%
  group_by(date) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(keep_cols), ~ sum(. != 0))) %>%
  pivot_longer(-date, names_to = "topic", values_to = "count") %>%
  left_join(corpus_df) %>%
  left_join(sum_pages_by_year) %>%
  mutate(proportion_corpus = count/num_pages,
         proportion_pages = count/pages)

write_csv(summary_table, "output/text_themes_by_year.csv")

# Get last year as latex table
cat(knitr::kable(
  summary_table %>% 
    filter(date==as.Date("2025-12-31")) %>%
    select(-date, -num_pages, -pages) %>%
    mutate(across(c("proportion_corpus","proportion_pages"), round, 4)) %>%
    arrange(-count)
    ,
  "latex")
  )
```

```{r Compare relative to 2005-12-31}
# See which themes have become more or less common
temp1 <- subset(summary_table, date==as.Date("2005-12-31")) %>% select(date, topic, proportion_pages) %>%
  arrange(date, topic) %>%
  rename(topic_2006=topic, proportion_2006=proportion_pages) %>%
  select(-date)
  
temp2 <- subset(summary_table, date==as.Date("2025-12-31")) %>% select(date, topic, proportion_pages) %>%
  arrange(date, topic) %>%
  rename(topic_2026=topic, proportion_2026=proportion_pages) %>%
  select(-date)

temp3 <- cbind(temp1, temp2)
temp3$diff <- temp3$proportion_2026 - temp3$proportion_2006

cat(knitr::kable(
  temp3 %>% 
    select(-topic_2026) %>%
    mutate(across(c("proportion_2026","proportion_2006","diff"), round, 4)) %>%
    arrange(-diff)
    ,
  "latex")
  )
```


```{r Hierarchical clustering controlling for paragraph length}
drop_cols <- c("politics_and_statehood", "migration_conquest",
               "sourcing_and_evidence", "hereditarian")

# Formatting function for correlations
fmt_corr <- function(x) {
  s <- sprintf("%.2f", x)
  s <- sub("^0\\.", ".", s)
  s <- sub("^-0\\.", "-.", s)
  s <- sub("^1\\.00$", "1", s)
  s <- sub("^-1\\.00$", "-1", s)
  s
}

# Get counts of paragraphs
temp <- pages_df %>%
  filter(date==as.Date("2025-12-31")) %>%
  count(page, sort = TRUE)

sum_pgh_presence_by_page_pgh_rate <-
  sum_pgh_presence_by_page %>% 
  filter(date==as.Date("2025-12-31")) %>% # 2025 only
  left_join(temp) %>% # join counts
  filter(!is.na(n)) # drop pages without paragraphs

# Proportions, restricted to pages with >=5 genetics paragraphs
prop_mat <- sum_pgh_presence_by_page_pgh_rate %>%
  filter(date == as.Date("2025-12-31"), n >= 5) %>%
  mutate(across(-c(page, date, n, all_of(drop_cols)), ~ .x / n)) %>%
  select(-page, -date, -n, -all_of(drop_cols))

mat <- cor(prop_mat)

#png("figures/hierarchical_clustering_topics_length_adjusted_2025.png", width = 800, height = 800)
hc <- hclust(as.dist(1 - mat), method = "average")
plot(hc, hang = -1, main = "Topic clustering (proportions, n >= 5)",
     xlab = "", sub = "", ylab = "1 - r")
rect.hclust(hc, k = 2, border = c("#D85A30", "#378ADD"))

#dev.off()
#dev.new()

topic_order <- hc$labels[hc$order]   # or any order you want

d <- cor(prop_mat) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>% rownames_to_column("v1") %>%
  pivot_longer(-v1, names_to = "v2", values_to = "r") %>%
  mutate(v1 = factor(v1, levels = topic_order),
         v2 = factor(v2, levels = topic_order)) %>%
  filter(as.integer(v1) < as.integer(v2))   # lower triangle, no diagonal

ggplot(d, aes(v1, v2, fill = r)) +
  geom_tile(color = NA) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", r), color = abs(r) > 0.5),
            size = 4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "white", "FALSE" = "grey20")) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = names(keep_cols) %>% setNames(keep_cols), limits = head(topic_order, -1)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = names(keep_cols) %>% setNames(keep_cols), limits = rev(tail(topic_order, -1))) +
  coord_fixed() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5, size=13),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size=13),
        legend.position = "none") 

#ggsave("figures/topics_text_corr_plot_length_adjusted.png", device="png",
#       width=10, height=10, dpi=300)
```


```{r Use PCA to extract some examples}

pca <- prcomp(prop_mat, scale. = TRUE)
round(pca$rotation[, 1:2], 2)
summary(pca)$importance[, 1:3]


example_idxs <- order(pca$x[,1], decreasing=TRUE)[1:5] # Find outliers along PC1

examples <- sum_pgh_presence_by_page_pgh_rate %>%
  filter(date == as.Date("2025-12-31"), n >= 5)

examples_pc1_high <- examples[example_idxs,]

example_idxs <- order(pca$x[,1], decreasing=FALSE)[1:5] # Find outliers along PC1 (other end)

examples <- sum_pgh_presence_by_page_pgh_rate %>%
  filter(date == as.Date("2025-12-31"), n >= 5)

examples_pc1_low <- examples[example_idxs,]

example_idxs <- order(pca$x[,2], decreasing=TRUE)[1:5] # Find outliers along PC2

examples <- sum_pgh_presence_by_page_pgh_rate %>%
  filter(date == as.Date("2025-12-31"), n >= 5)

examples_pc2_high <- examples[example_idxs,]

example_idxs <- order(pca$x[,2], decreasing=FALSE)[1:5] # Find outliers along PC2 (other end)

examples <- sum_pgh_presence_by_page_pgh_rate %>%
  filter(date == as.Date("2025-12-31"), n >= 5)

examples_pc2_low <- examples[example_idxs,]
```

# Talk page data

```{r Analyze talk page data}

talk_data_dir <- "data/talk_page_discussions_with_keywords/genetics_discussions" # genetics discussions
nongenetics_talk_data_dir <- "" # nongenetics discussions

talk_skipped <- as.logical(readLines(file.path(talk_data_dir, "skipped_counts.txt")))
talk_term_counts <- read_csv(file.path(talk_data_dir, "term_counts.csv"))

# Extract page name
talk_term_counts$page <- sapply(strsplit(talk_term_counts$id, ".txt#"), `[`, 1)

# Import discussion IDs for each page
idx_dir <- file.path(talk_data_dir, "paragraphs_indices")

# Import the discussion IDs for each file
discussion_ids <- data.frame()
for (f in list.files(idx_dir)){
  temp_ids <- readLines(file.path(idx_dir, f))
  discussion_ids <- rbind(discussion_ids, data.frame(id = temp_ids))
  #revisions_df <- rbind(revisions_df, data.frame(date = fulldate, revision = revisions))
}

# Drop skipped observations to line up with talk_term_counts
# BUG: These are misaligned. No impact on analysis but could muck things up elsewhere.
discussion_ids <- discussion_ids[!talk_skipped, ,drop=FALSE]

# Attach discussion IDs to talk term counts
talk_term_counts$discussion_id <- discussion_ids$id

# Drop document variable--redundant with page
talk_term_counts <- talk_term_counts[,!(colnames(talk_term_counts) %in% c("document"))]

# Reorder columns
talk_term_counts <- talk_term_counts %>%
  select(page, discussion_id, id,
         total_terms, population_genetics_methods, statistical_clustering, ancestry_and_origins,
         phenotype_physical, medical_genetics, group_comparison, subsistence_mode, admixture_and_mixing,
         archaic_and_deep_lineage, social_structure, migration_conquest, race_classification,
         identity_and_ethnicity, language_and_linguistics, sourcing_and_evidence, religion, politics_and_statehood,
         hereditarian, culture_and_tradition)

# Summarize each of the variables at these levels
term_cols <- c(
  "population_genetics_methods",
  "statistical_clustering",
  "ancestry_and_origins",
  "phenotype_physical",
  "medical_genetics",
  "group_comparison",
  "subsistence_mode",
  "admixture_and_mixing",
  "archaic_and_deep_lineage",
  "social_structure",
  "migration_conquest",
  "race_classification",
  "identity_and_ethnicity",
  "language_and_linguistics",
  "sourcing_and_evidence",
  "religion",
  "politics_and_statehood",
  "hereditarian",
  "culture_and_tradition"
  )

# Columns to keep
keep_cols <- c(
  "population_genetics_methods",
  "statistical_clustering",
  "ancestry_and_origins",
  "phenotype_physical",
  "medical_genetics",
  "group_comparison",
  "subsistence_mode",
  "admixture_and_mixing",
  "archaic_and_deep_lineage",
  "social_structure",
  #"migration_conquest",
  "race_classification",
  "identity_and_ethnicity",
  "language_and_linguistics",
  #"sourcing_and_evidence",
  "religion",
  #"politics_and_statehood",
  "hereditarian"
  #"culture_and_tradition"
  )

names(keep_cols) <- c(
  "Popgen methods",
  "Statistics & clustering",
  "Ancestry & origins",
  "Phenotypes",
  "Medical genetics",
  "Group comparison",
  "Subsistence",
  "Admixture",
  "Archaic",
  "Social structure",
  #"migration_conquest",
  "Race",
  "Identity & ethnicity",
  "Language",
  #"Sourcing",
  "Religion",
  #"Politics & statehood",
  "Hereditarianism"
  #"Culture & tradition"
  )

# Sum by page
# Number of times a word related to a topic appears in a page
sum_by_page <- talk_term_counts %>%
  group_by(page) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(term_cols), sum))

# Sum by page and discussion_id
# Number of times a word related to a topic appears in a discussion
sum_by_page_discussion <- talk_term_counts %>%
  group_by(page, discussion_id) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(term_cols), sum), .groups = "drop")

# Presence by page (any non-zero across rows for that page)
# Whether a topic appears at all in a talk page
presence_by_page <- talk_term_counts %>%
  group_by(page) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(term_cols), ~ as.integer(any(. != 0))))

# Presence by page and discussion_id
# Whether a topic appears at all in a discussion
presence_by_page_discussion <- talk_term_counts %>%
  group_by(page, discussion_id) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(term_cols), ~ as.integer(any(. != 0))), .groups = "drop")

# Sum of presence by page
# Number of discussions that mention the topics
sum_presence_by_page <- presence_by_page_discussion %>%
  group_by(page) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(term_cols), sum))

# Proportion by page
proportion_by_page <- presence_by_page_discussion %>%
  group_by(page) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(term_cols), ~ mean(. != 0)))

```


```{r Visualize talk topic data}

# First, plot the number of discussions by topic (in total)
# Second, plot the number of pages with discussion topics

# Third, highlight some outliers (hereditarianism)
# These can lead into the Grokipedia analysis (to see how hereditarianism lives on in AI)

# 1. Plot number of discussions by topic

df_plotting_talk <- sum_presence_by_page %>%
  pivot_longer(-page, names_to = "topic", values_to = "count")

df_plotting_talk <- sum_presence_by_page %>%
  select(-page) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "topic", values_to = "count") %>%
  filter(topic %in% keep_cols)

ggplot(df_plotting_talk, aes(x = reorder(topic, -count), y = count)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_endline() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(names(keep_cols), keep_cols)) +
  ggtitle("Talk page discussions mentioning a topic") +
  xlab("Topic") + ylab("Count")

#ggsave("figures/talk_page_topics_count.png", device = "png", dpi=300,
#       width=8, height=6)

#2. Plot number of pages with discussions

df_plotting_talk <- presence_by_page %>%
  select(-page) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), sum)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "topic", values_to = "count") %>%
  filter(topic %in% keep_cols)

ggplot(df_plotting_talk, aes(x = reorder(topic, -count), y = count)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_endline() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = setNames(names(keep_cols), keep_cols)) +
  ggtitle("Talk pages mentioning a topic") +
  xlab("Topic") + ylab("Count")

#ggsave("figures/talk_page_topics_count_by_page.png", device = "png", dpi=300,
#       width=8, height=6)

slice_max(sum_presence_by_page[,c("page","hereditarian")], n=5, order_by = hereditarian)
```
